XECH Magneto Lite Lamp – Smart, Stylish & Ultra-Versatile Lighting

The XECH Magneto Lite Lamp is a next-generation portable lighting solution designed for modern homes, workspaces, and on-the-go lifestyles. Featuring a detachable magnetic lamp head with a 360° rotatable design, this lamp adapts effortlessly to your lighting needs. Whether you need focused task lighting, ambient illumination, or a portable rechargeable lamp, Magneto Lite delivers performance with premium aesthetics.

Crafted with a premium metal build and engineered with glare-free LEDs, the lamp ensures eye comfort while maintaining high brightness efficiency. Its sleek design blends seamlessly into contemporary interiors, making it perfect for bedrooms, desks, kitchens, wardrobes, and travel use.

Detachable Magnetic Lamp Head with 360° Rotation

The detachable magnetic head allows quick removal and repositioning, offering unmatched flexibility. Thanks to the 360-degree rotatable head, you can direct light exactly where you need it, making it ideal for reading, working, or accent lighting. The strong magnetic attachment ensures stability while remaining easy to detach when required.

Multiple Attachments for Maximum Versatility

Designed for multi-purpose use, the Magneto Lite includes multiple mounting attachments that allow you to place it on walls, tables, cabinets, or use it as a handheld light. This makes it a perfect solution for study rooms, wardrobes, kitchens, stairways, and even emergency lighting.

  • Wall-mounted magnetic attachment
  • Desk and bedside placement
  • Portable handheld usage
  • Ideal for home, office, and travel

Enjoy effortless control with control functionality that lets you switch between three brightness modes—low, medium, and high. Whether you need soft ambient lighting or bright task illumination, the adjusts instantly with a simple, enhancing convenience and usability.

USB-C Rechargeable for Long-Lasting Performance

The ensures fast charging and long battery life, eliminating the need for constant replacements or wired usage. A single charge delivers hours of reliable illumination, making it an energy-efficient and eco-friendly lighting solution for everyday use.

Premium Metal Build with Glare-Free LEDs

Built with durability in mind, the features a premium metal body that adds strength and elegance. The integrated glare-free LED technology reduces eye strain and flicker, making it suitable for prolonged usage such as studying, working, or reading at night.

Why Choose?

  • Detachable magnetic head for flexible use
  • 360° rotatable design for precise light direction
  • USB-C rechargeable with long battery life
  • Premium metal build for durability and style
  • Glare-free LEDs for eye comfort
  • Versatile and portable for indoor and outdoor use

Perfect for Every Space

The is designed to complement multiple environments—from modern homes and offices to travel and emergency use. Its minimalist design, combined with advanced lighting features, makes it an excellent choice for users looking for a, rechargeable magnetic, or a multi-purpose desk light. Upgrade your lighting experience with a that combines innovation, functionality, and premium design. Choose Magneto Lite for a smarter, more adaptable way to illuminate your space.

Key Features:

  • MOQ 100 Units.
  • Price does not include GST, logo printing and delivery charges
  • Detachable Magnetic Lamp Head – use it as a table lamp or remove it for a handheld torch.
  • 360° Rotatable Design – strong neodymium magnet allows flexible and precise light positioning.
  • Multiple Attachments – includes a sturdy base and rod for table use, plus clamp/stick-on options for mounting anywhere.
  • Touch Control with 3 Brightness Modes – easily switch between low, medium, and high light intensity.
  • USB-C Rechargeable – built-in rechargeable battery for cordless, eco-friendly operation.
  • Premium Metal Build – stylish, durable, and stable for long-term use.
  • Glare-Free LEDs – soft, eye-friendly illumination suitable for reading and working.
  • Versatile & Portable – ideal for study, work, bedside, travel, or emergencies.
